units.source_text: 到了元旦，源氏是太政大臣，不须入朝贺年，在家甚是安闲。

en.t: When New Year's Day came, Genji, being Chancellor, did not need to go to court to offer New Year greetings, and spent the time quietly at home.

units.source_text: 正月初七日白马节会，按照古昔藤原良房大臣先例，把白马牵入太政大臣邸内，其仪式仿效宫中，比古昔更为隆重庄严。

en.t: At the White Horse Festival on the seventh day of the first month, following the ancient precedent of Minister Fujiwara no Yoshifusa, white horses were led into the Chancellor's residence, and the ceremony, modeled on that of the palace, was even more solemn and magnificent than in olden times.

units.source_text: 二月二十日，冷泉帝行幸朱雀院。

en.t: On the twentieth day of the second month, Emperor Reizei made an imperial visit to Suzaku-in.
At that time, the spring blossoms had not yet fully opened.

units.source_text: 但因三月是藤壶母后忌月，所以提前行幸。

en.t: But since the third month was the memorial month for the Empress Mother Fujitsubo, the imperial visit was held early.

units.source_text: 早樱已经开花，颜色十分鲜丽。

en.t: The early cherry blossoms had already opened, and their colors were extraordinarily fresh and bright.

units.source_text: 是日朱雀院内布置陈设，特别讲究，万事尽善尽美。

en.t: That day, the arrangements and furnishings within Suzaku-in were especially elaborate, and everything was brought to the height of perfection.

units.source_text: 随驾行幸的公卿亲王等，也都打扮得齐齐整整。

en.t: The court nobles, princes, and others attending the imperial procession were all impeccably dressed as well.

units.source_text: 他们都穿绿袍，罩在白面红里的衬袍上。

en.t: They all wore green robes layered over under-robes with white outer fabric and crimson lining.
Emperor Reizei, by contrast, wore a crimson robe.

units.source_text: 有旨宣召太政大臣同行，故源氏也来到朱雀院。

en.t: An imperial command summoned the Chancellor to accompany the procession, and so Genji also came to Suzaku-in.

units.source_text: 他所穿的也是红袍，因此两人一样光辉灿烂，几乎教人不能分辨。

en.t: He too was wearing a crimson robe, so the two of them shone with such equal brilliance that people could scarcely tell them apart.

units.source_text: 此次行幸，各人装束及各种布置，都比往常更加讲究。

en.t: For this imperial visit, everyone's attire and all the arrangements were more carefully prepared than usual.

units.source_text: 已经退位的朱雀院，比前更加清健了，容貌姿态异常优美。

en.t: The retired Suzaku-in seemed even more serene and healthy than before, and his face and bearing were exceptionally elegant.
